en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a street corner with a multi‑story building housing a guesthouse or restaurant and, to the right, a broad stone staircase leading up through a baroque archway into a leafy garden or terrace. Tables with umbrellas stand beside the steps. German text is printed both on the building façades and in the lower margin, which identifies the location as Meissen on the Elbe River and mentions the establishment "Gaststätte zum Bräustüberl".
